title: MessagesRequest
description: Request body for creating a message.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model slug to use. Find available models at [Model APIs](https://app.baseten.co/model-apis/create).

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The conversation history as an ordered list of input messages. Alternating `user` and `assistant` roles are expected; the final message must be from the `user`.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. Required by the Messages API. The response may be shorter if it finishes naturally or hits a stop sequence.

system.title: System
system.description: A system prompt that sets the model's behavior. Pass either a single string or an array of text content blocks.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower values are more deterministic. Range: 0 to 1.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only consider tokens with cumulative probability up to this value.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Limits token selection to the top K most probable tokens at each step.

stop_sequences.title: Stop Sequences
stop_sequences.description: Custom text sequences that will stop generation. When a stop sequence is hit, `stop_reason` is `stop_sequence` and `stop_sequence` contains the matched string.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: If `true`, the response is streamed as server-sent events. Each event has a `type` such as `message_start`, `content_block_delta`, or `message_stop`.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Each tool has a `name`, `description`, and `input_schema` (a JSON Schema object).

tool_choice.description: Controls which tool (if any) the model must call.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: An object describing metadata about the request. Supports `user_id` for abuse detection.

user_id.description: An external identifier for the end user.
